author: ImRaging
body:
THIS IS NOT A TROLL APPEAL

Im going straight to the point here:

basically stevens ign in ts was gram so i changed mine to ing (raging). Obviously this isnt allowed so he kicked me (fair enough). I then came back and changed my name to 'rag' which most people would know me by, however he still told me to change it. I changed it to ginger because most apollo people call me raginger (no joke) and surely this would be fine? If steven can have his name as gram, why cant i have mine as ginger?

title: TS Tempban

replies.author: Protel
replies.body: "Howdy there Raging; it's Zac. As I explained to you originally the reason for the rule is so that we can correctly document TS infractions. A user can be asked by any staff member who believes that the user's TS username does not identify who that player is to change that username. The only names that a user is guaranteed to be allowed to use is their IGN(s) and former IGN(s) that link back to their avicus profile assuming it is appropriate. In your case I did not find that these other TS usernames you were using clearly identified you as who you are and asked to you to change it. You refused at certain points and were punished accordingly, you were given ample warning and you were made aware of the consequences that would follow. Steven handled his username correctly and cleared it by a staff member before setting it so that the staff member was satisfied that it clearly identified him. Your punishment also came as a result of your attempt to troll by changing your username to "yourIGN" and "IGN" not from "rag" as you stated; although you did set it as "rag" at which point I told you to change it. This is an appeal not a report, if you would like to report steven for violating rules, which he is not doing, please do so separate of your appeal. This appeal is denied."
